empty: No images or videos found in the configured directories
not_installed_hint: mpvpaper is not installed: videos cannot be played, images still work

auto_pause.description: Pause playback while a fullscreen window covers the wallpaper (mpvpaper --auto-pause)
auto_pause.label: Pause When Covered

extra_directory.description: Optional second folder to scan, for keeping images and videos apart; leave empty to use one source
extra_directory.label: Extra Directory

extract_last_frame.description: Extract a frame from the video to use as the static wallpaper when playback stops; off falls back to whatever wallpaper the host already has
extract_last_frame.label: Static Fallback Frame

fit_mode.description: How a video is framed when its aspect ratio does not match the output. Fill crops the overflowing edges; Fit letterboxes instead, which keeps a video no larger than the screen pixel-for-pixel sharp; Stretch distorts it to fit exactly
fit_mode.label: Fit Mode

glsl_shader.description: Optional mpv GLSL user shader to run on the video, for upscalers such as Anime4K, FSRCNNX or ravu. Costs more GPU than any built-in scaler and the path cannot contain spaces
glsl_shader.label: GLSL Shader

keep_host_wallpaper.description: Keep the host wallpaper alive underneath a playing video, set to the video's still frame. The video covers it, and Noctalia panels that draw the current wallpaper (such as the control center user card) keep working. Off drops the host surface to save a texture
keep_host_wallpaper.label: Keep Host Wallpaper

max_depth.description: How many levels below each source folder to walk
max_depth.label: Search Depth

media_directory.description: Folder scanned for wallpaper images and videos; defaults to the wallpaper folder from your Noctalia settings
media_directory.label: Media Directory

mpv_options.description: Additional space-separated mpv options, e.g. panscan=1.0 video-zoom=0.1
mpv_options.label: Extra mpv Options

recursive.description: Walk subfolders too, so one directory containing videos/ and images/ lists everything
recursive.label: Search Subfolders

render_quality.description: High switches mpv to a sharper scaler and turns on debanding, which is worth it when a video is smaller than the screen and has to be scaled up. It runs on every frame, so it draws GPU power the whole time the wallpaper plays
render_quality.label: Render Quality

run_as_systemd.description: Run the wallpaper in a systemd transient scope to enforce strict resource limits
run_as_systemd.label: Run as systemd Service

title: Media Wallpaper
truncated: Showing the first {count} files. Narrow the directories or reduce the search depth
unreadable: None of the configured directories could be read
unsupported_file: Not a supported image or video: {name}
